(ta)༄༅/ /dmag zor rgyal mo'i rjes gnang bya tshul bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /na mo gu ru rat+na shrī wā ne/bla ma mchog dang gshin rje gshed/ /dbyer med zha

tei:div.tei:p: (ta)༄༅// dmag zor rgyal mo'i rjes gnang bya tshul bzhugs so// ༄༅// na mo gu ru rat+na shrī wā ne/ bla ma mchog dang gshin rje gshed// dbyer med zhabs la gus btud nas// de yi bka' srung drag mo'i gtso// dmag zor gnyan gyi re wa tī'i// rjes gnang bya tshul cho ga'i rim// tshig nyung don gsal go bde bas// blo gsal mgrin pa mdzes bya'i phyir// dpal ldan bla ma'i gsung bzhin bri// de la sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ gnas khang mtshan nyid dang ldan pa yid du 'ong bar/ stegs ji ltar rigs par li la sogs pa'i maṇ+ḍal gang 'byor la gri khrag dang ro sol byugs pa'am/ ma 'byor na chang la bdud rtsi ril bu btab pa byugs la bskam/ de'i steng rdul tshon dmar pos chos 'byung bris/ gong ras dang chos 'byung gi bar mu khyud sor gcig tsam bskor ba ljang gu/ chos 'byung gi mtha'i zla gam sngon po/ de rnams kyi bcad dmar pos byas la bzhag de'i steng mañji'i khar mtshan ldan gyi thod pa'am/ snod gtsang mar gtor chog tu bshad pa ltar skong gtor bshos bu bzhi dang bcas pa mda' dar nag po'i steng du lha mo'i sku tsa ka li rab gnas can btsugs pa bzhag de'i g.yas su sman phud/ g.yon du rak+ta/ mdun du khrag gi mchod yon/ dbang po'i me tog tshil chen gyi bdug spos/ zhun chen gyi mar me/ mkhris pa'i dri chab/ sha rus kyi zhal zas rnams phyag len bzhin bsham/ slob ma la dgos pa'i thod pa mtshan ldan gyi nang du nang mchod cung zad blugs/ seng ldeng gi be con/ slob dpon gyi mdun du nang mchod la bu ram dang bdud rtsi ril bu btab pa slob ma du yod par ldang ba bsham pa'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ slob dpon rang nyid kyi bya ba yi dam gang rung gi bdag bskyed bsgoms la/ lha mo la gtor chog ltar gtor ma phul/ bzlas pa byas/ skong ba dang bstod pa rgyas bsdus gang rung byas nas/

slob ma'i bya ba ni/ slob ma gshin rje'i gshed dam/ bla med gang yang rung ba'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs par thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pa bdun la sogs pa zung du ma gyur pa ji ltar rigs pa khrus byas par mos nas chab blangs la nang du 'ong dus/ las kyi rdo rjes slob ma rnams gu gul gyis bdug rol mo drag tu bya/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje gsor/ dril bu gsil/ yi dam gang byas kyi sngags bzlas pas bgegs bskrad/ slob ma rnams gral la 'khod pa la/ me tog bkye bsdu tshar ba dang*/ slob dpon gyis/ 'o gnas skabs su 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad nye bar zhi zhing*/ mthar thug bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya ba'i ched du/ rjes su gnang ba zab mo gsan snyam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa gsal btab nas gsan par zhu/ de la 'dir chos skyong ba'i srung ma bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod pa'i nang nas/ shin tu zab pa dpal ldan lha mo 'dod pa'i khams kyi dbang phyug ma zhes grags pa 'di sngon gyi bstan bcos 'chi med mdzod dang*/ de'i 'grel pa rab 'byor zla bas mdzad pa dang*/ yang sna tshogs gsal ba zhes bya ba ming gzhan du mu tig phreng bar grags pa slob dpon dpal 'dzin sdes mdzad pa sogs las u ma dang gcig par bshad nas ming gi rnam grangs dgu bcu tsam du gsungs shing gzungs bsdus kyi nang du lha mo'i bstod pa dang mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad bshad/ gsang sngags rnying ma'i rgyud rnams las sngags srung drag mo'i sgrub tshul rab tu mang po dang*/ lhag ma'i skabs su yang rgyas par bshad la/ gsang sngags gsar 'gyur gyi bya ba'i rgyud rig pa mchog gi rgyud las/ phyag na rdo rjes nam gru'i rigs dang cho 'brang la bstod nas sangs rgyas kyis dkyil 'khor du bcug nas dbang bskur te gsang sngags spyi'i srung mar bskos shing rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud rdo rje gdan bzhi/

rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud/ kye rdo rje brtag gnyis/ saṃ bu ṭa'i rgyud sogs las bshad pa'i yul nyer bzhi dang*/ gnas so gnyis kyi nang tshan de wī ko ṭa zhes pa bod skad du lha mo'i mkhar zhes pa de na gnas nas zhing skyong ma mo thams cad kyi gtso mo mdzad par bshad/ phyi rol pa'i lha mo'i gnas mkhar dang gnas mchog gi rgyud sogs las kyang ches mang bar bshad/ bod du bka' srol yang bla ma mal lo tsā ba nas rje sa skya pa yab sras sogs nas brgyud pa dang*/ yang jo bo nā ro pa nas mar pa lo tsā ba la brgyud pa dud sol lha mor btags pa dang*/ gzhan yang dmag dang zor gyi las gtso bor sgrub pa'i dmag zor rgyal mo la sogs pa mo rkyang gi sgrub skor rab tu mang bar snang ba las/ 'dir dpal ldan lha mo re wa tī dmag zor rgyal mo'i rjes su gnang ba sgrub par byed pa la/ gang gis rjes su gnang bar byed pa'i slob dpon ni/ gshin rje'i gshed dam yi dam gang yang rung ba'i bsnyen pa las su rung bar song zhing*/ khyad par dpal ldan lha mo nyid kyi rjes gnang thob pa zhig gis byed dgos/ gang la bya ba'i slob ma ni/ gshin rje'i gshed la sogs pa bla med kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob cing dam tshig dang sdom par ldan pa gcig nas bdun gyi bar du zung ma gyur pa cig la bya dgos shing*/ nam bya ba'i dus ni nyi shu dgu la sogs pa'i dus bzang gang rung la bya zhing*/ ji ltar bya ba'i cho ga ni/ slob dpon gyis yi dam gang yang rung ba'i bdag bskyed sngon du song nas dpal ldan lha mo nyid la mchod gtor 'bul ba'i rim pa rnams legs par grub ste/ khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa slob ma'i bya ba la/ bla ma dang bcom ldan 'das gshin rje'i gshed tha dad med pa'i rjes su gnang ba zab mo zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar du mdzod/

gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// sogs sh+lo ka gcig gtso bo lha mor bcas pa yi// sku gsung thugs la skyabs su mchi// dpal ldan lha mo'i rjes gnang gi /dngos grub dam pa stsal du gsol// de ltar gsol ba btab nas rgyud dag par bya ba'i phyir dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i bcom ldan 'das gshin rje'i gshed la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'i spyan sngar khyed rang rnams 'khod nas sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa yan lag bdun pa bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs brjod/ de ltar rgyud dag par byas nas rjes su gnang ba sgrub par byed pa la/ thog mar sku'i rjes su gnang ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar mdzod/ he ru ka dpal rdo rje can// dpa' bo chen po dgongs su gsol// shākya seng ge'i bstan pa la// byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do// gtso bo ston pa'i bka' srung gis// 'dren pa'i bstan pa bsrung ba dang*// sems can kun la sman slad du// ma mo drag mo la sogs pa'i// mthu dang dngos grub 'byung ba'i rgyu// dam tshig can de bdag la stsol// de ltar gsol ba btab nas khyed rang rnams dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon la dpal ldan lha mo dngos yin snyam pa'i gus 'dud drag po dung pa byas pas/ slob dpon gyis thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus la phog pas stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las rlung nag 'tshubs ma'i gur khang me ri rab tu 'bar ba'i nang du/ rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi la sogs pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su khrag zhag 'khrugs pa'i klong dkyil du/ khyed rang rnams kyi sems nyid k+ṣaḥlas be con k+ṣaḥs mtshan pa las/

dpal ldan lha mo re wa tī dmag zor rgyal mo drel rta la zhon pa/ sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing mi ro rengs pa khar bcug pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ smin ma'i dbus su khro gnyer rab tu bsdus pa/ dbu skra kham pa gyen du brdzes pa la me lce dang me stag du ma 'phro ba/ snyan g.yas pa la dug sbrul dang g.yon pa la seng ges brgyan pa/ mi mgo skam po lngas dbur brgyan cing*/ rgyu ma la brgyus pa'i rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ sku la khrag gi thig le zhag gi zo ris thal chen gyi tshom bu bkod pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi cod pan dang lhab lhub kyis bklubs pa/ zhing chen gyi g.yang gzhi dang re ldes stod g.yogs pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ sbrul gyi ska rags dang do shal la sogs pa dpal gyi chas brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i tsan+dan gyi be con nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon yungs kar dang khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ sga'i snga sha la nad kyi rkyal pa/ btsan gyi byad dmar/ shwa rde'u dkar nag 'phyang ba/ phyi sha la tshon gyi gru gu btags shing bdud kyi khrom shing sked la gzer ba/ lte ba'i thad ka nas nyi ma dang spyi gtsug nas zla ba 'char ba/ dbu'i steng du rma bya'i gdugs phub pa/ 'khor bdud phrug bye ba'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa mig rtsa dmar zhing rab tu khros pa'i cha lugs can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yon na yungs kar dang khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/ g.yas mtshon cha sna tshogs pa bsnams pa dpag tu med pas bskor nas bzhugs pa'i sku can re rer gyur pa'i snying gar bh+yoḥyig mthing nag las 'od zer 'phros pas/ byang shar mtsho mu le ding nas dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo'i sku dpag tu med pa/ gzhan yang rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma/ yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bsam gyis mi khyab pa kha ba bu yug 'tshubs pa ltar byon nas khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo la sogs pa'i ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas sib sib thim pas/

gnas skabs su lus kyi bar chad zhi zhing lha mo'i sku'i byin rlabs zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces dang*/ bdag bskyed yi dam gang byas kyi sngags kyi mjug tu ā we sha ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pa'i sngags rnams yang yang brjod/ lha mo rang gi sbyar spos sam/ gu gul gyis bdug rol mo sogs bya/ de nas lha mo'i phyag mtshan be con dang thod pa khyed rang rnams kyi lag tu gtad cing byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces dang rtsa sngags brjod cing gtad tshar ba dang*/ lha mo'i gtor ma slob ma'i mgo thog tu bzhag la/ ma mo mkha' 'gro dam tshig can// ma sring mdza' mo bran mo yi// tshul gyis sgrub pa'i srung ma ru// ma bas byams shing sring bas brtse// grogs pas gdungs shing bran pas nyan// bka' sdod srung ma'i dbang thob shog /rak+mo bh+yoḥsogs kyi mjug tu ma ma trag rak+ṣa sa ma ya zhes pa dang*/ sngon tshe rdo rje 'chang gi spyan snga ru// chos bzhin sgrub par byed pa'i gang zag la// bar chad srung zhing skyong bar zhal bzhes pa'i// chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /de rnams kyis sku'i byin rlabs zhugs/ lus kyi dri ma dag dpal ldan lha mo dmag zor rgyal mo khyed rang rnams kyi lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de ni sku'i rjes gnang ngo*// gnyis pa gsung gi rjes gnang gi don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ he ru ka dpal rdo rje can// sogs gong bzhin dang*/ de ltar gsol ba btab nas/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor gtor ma bzhag cing byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces dang*/ gtor ma mgo thog tu bzhag ste/ dam rdzas gtor ma'i dbang bskur bas// gsung gi phrin las lhun grub nas// dam can 'du zhing 'khor ba dang*// dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i dbang thob shog /rak+mo sogs kyi mjug tu a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐ zhes brjod cing tshar ba dang gtor ma bsdus/

rak+mo bh+yoḥsogs brjod cing nang mchod nas slob ma rnams bdud rtsi byin nas/ gong bzhin bkra shis brjod/ de nas bla ma'i zhal nas lha mo'i rtsa sngags rak+mo bh+yoḥsogs kyi sngags phreng byung*/ khyed rang gi zhal du zhugs/ snying ga'i bh+yoḥyig la thim pas gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs par mos nas/ sngags 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar mdzod/ bh+yoḥrak+mo bh+yoḥ rak+mo bh+yoḥbh+yoḥ rak+mo thun bh+yoḥ kha la rag chen mo/ rak+mo a bya ta bya thun bh+yoḥ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yoḥhūm̐/ zhes bh+yoḥbadun ma lan gsum gyi bar du rjes zlos byed du bcug de ltar byas pas lha mo'i gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs par mos nas/ ngag gi dri ma dag lha mo la bka' ji ltar bsgos pa sgrub par mos pa mdzod/ de ni gsung gi rjes gnang ngo*// gsum pa thugs kyi rjes gnang gi don du gong bzhin/ he ru ka dpal sogs lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ yang gtor ma mgo thog tu bzhag ste/ dam rdzas gtor mas dbang bskur bas// thugs kyi phrin las lhun grub nas// dam can 'du zhing 'khor ba dang*// dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i dbang thob shog /rak+mo dang*/ tsit+ta ma hā su kha dz+nyā na dhā tu hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing gong bzhin bdud rtsi byin/ bkra shis/ de ltar bdud rtsi byin pa de nyid snying ga'i bh+yoḥyig la thim pas bh+yoḥyig shel ltar dwangs la gsal bas snang ba thams cad khyab pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de ltar bsams pas lha mo'i thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ sems kyi dri ma dag khyed rang rnams kyi sems dang lha mo'i thugs gnyis su med par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de ni thugs kyi rjes gnang ngo*// phrin las gtor ma la brten nas bka' bsgo zhing byin gyis brlab pa'i don du/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar du mdzod/ gong bzhin he ru ka dpal brjod/ de ltar gsol ba btab nas dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/

slob dpon la gus 'dud dung pa byas pas slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu dpag tu med pa 'phros pas lha mo'i thugs ka'i bh+yoḥyig dbang med du bkug nas khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar thim pa la brten nas phrin las rnam pa bzhi gang bcol bsgrub par mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod la gtor ma mgo thog bzhag la/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar gyi rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar dam tshig srungs/ bstan pa skyongs/ khyad par du sngon rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang gi spyan sngar khas blangs pa ltar/ rdo rje slob ma khyed rnams kyis chos sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*/ mthun rkyen tshe dang bsod nams legs pa'i yon tan thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang*/ zhi rgyas dbang drag gi phrin las thams cad 'bad med lhun grub tu sgrub pa'i phrin las mdzod cig lha mo'i rtsa sngags rak+mo sogs dang*/ ma ma sarba karma sid+dhi ku ru zhes brjod/ rol mo dang bdug pa sogs byas la/ de nas gong bzhin bkra shis brjod/ de ltar phrin las gtor ma la brten nas bka' bsgos pas shākya seng ge'i spyan sngar ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas pa ltar khyed rang rnams kyis gang bsgo ba rnams ji ltar bsam pa bzhin bsgrub par lha mos khas blangs shing dam bcas par bsam mo// de rnams kyi sgo nas rjes gnang zab mo thob pas/ de dag gi gnas skabs su khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa tshul bzhin du bsrung bsdam bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos sogs dang*/ rjes gnang thob pa'i gtang rag tu maṇ+ḍal phul/ deng nas sogs gsum/ de rnams kyis dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo'i rjes gnang thob pas rang gzhan gyi don rgya che bar mdzod/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs spyi 'gre/

gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba ni gtor chog bzhin/ tsa ka li la brtan bzhugs bya/ maṇ+ḍal bsdu'o// de ltar dmag zor rgyal mo yi// rjes su gnang ba bya ba'i tshul// gsal bar bkod pa'i dge ba yis// dpal ldan lha mos rjes 'dzin shog /ces pa 'di ni rje btsun chos kyi rgyal po dkon mchog dpal ldan gyi gsung las ji ltar zin pa de'i zhabs rdul spyi bos gus par len pa shākya'i dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa byams pa kun dga' bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ shrī e waṃ chos ldan gyi gtsug lag khang chen por legs par sbyar ba'o// //sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
